item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Azure Front Door TLS key exchange policy with post-quantum support
item.description:
Azure Front Door now offers configurable TLS key exchange policies, including hybrid post-quantum key exchange. This lets you balance cryptographic readiness with client compatibility requirements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: MCP gateway for Application Gateway for Containers
item.description:
Application Gateway for Containers now supports Model Context Protocol (MCP) routing in preview via a new MCPRoute custom resource. This lets platform teams expose MCP servers behind a stable hostname and path while centralizing TLS and JWT validation through Web Application Firewall features.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Keyless TLS on Application Gateway with Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
item.description:
Azure Application Gateway now supports keyless TLS termination with certificates stored in Azure Key Vault Managed HSM. During TLS handshakes, signatures are performed inside the HSM and the private key is not exported to the gateway.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: security: Post-quantum authentication: Why organizations should start testing certificate ecosystems now
item.description:
Microsoft says organizations should begin testing certificate ecosystems now to prepare for post-quantum authentication. The post highlights Microsoft’s PQC TLS Pilot Program as a way to validate readiness for future post-quantum TLS deployments.

  • Source: Microsoft Security Blog

item.title: github: X25519-only TLS ends for GHE.com on October 7
item.description:
Starting October 7, 2026, GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (GHE.com) will stop accepting TLS connections from clients that support only X25519 for key agreement. Most customers are not expected to be affected.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: TLS/SSL certificate and end-to-end TLS encryption support for Azure Functions Flex Consumption
item.description:
Azure Functions Flex Consumption now generally supports TLS/SSL certificates using a new site-scoped certificate model. It also adds end-to-end TLS encryption support for function apps in this plan.

  • Source: Azure Updates
